title: Private Idol Disc Vol. 5: Nanako Fujisaki
native_title: プラドル・ディスク Ｖｏｌ．５ ～藤崎奈々子～
overview: Private Idol Disc Vol. 5: Fujisaki Nanako is a multimedia photobook of gravure idol Nanako Fujisaki. It includes a gallery of photos and video clips of the idol, as well as a simple rock-paper-scissors minigame and a quiz minigame. Completing the minigames will give the player passwords to unlock bonus photos.
